facts.fact: NIMC's Director-General said the Nigerian Immigration Service now uses the NIN for issuing and renewing passports.
NIMC's Director-General said many insurance companies, financial institutions and public agencies are already integrated into the national digital public infrastructure, without naming them.
facts.system: NIMC-integrated insurers, financial institutions and agencies

facts.fact: NIMC's Director-General named immigration, insurance and financial institutions as using or integrated with the NIN, three sectors, on her own statement and without figures.
